subject: science
concept: Observing and describing the weather, and how it changes day to day
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes real or virtual weather conditions and records them on a simple weather chart
exercise.pictorial: Student matches weather icons (sunny, rainy, windy) to their descriptions
exercise.abstract: Student describes today's weather using appropriate vocabulary

misconception_flags: confuses weather (day-to-day) with climate/season concepts not yet introduced

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
